added.01: Insights can now show the last 90 days.
added.02: Progress is renamed to Insights, and now opens on four tabs.
added.03: The Nutrition tab charts protein, fat and fiber too.
added.04: The Meals tab now shows your averages and your usual foods.
added.05: The Goals tab now shows how often you met each goal.
added.06: Overview now opens with a summary of your chosen time span.
added.07: The data screen says what is inside the JSON download.

changed.01: The app no longer mentions openplate-gateway.

fixed.01: A saved meal now reaches the server by itself.
fixed.02: Signing out no longer says everything reached the server when it has not.
fixed.03: The app no longer says the server cannot read your diary.

changed.01: The server now runs as one process in the container.

added.01: The streak on the home screen and on Progress is now the number of days you used the app.
added.02: A new screen lists what you have done with the app.
added.03: Your past counts: the app rebuilds the record from the diary you already have.
added.04: What counts as using the app, and what the record survives.
added.05: Your backup file moves to version 23.
added.06: The instance can hold a food database key, and says so when the database refuses.
